cohort: 129 women with FGM attending a specialized clinic for obstetric reasons
finding: Specialized care for pregnant women with FGM, including defibulation, can result in obstetric outcomes comparable to women without FGM.
mod_finding: Obstetric outcomes, including mode of delivery, were similar between women with different types of female genital mutilation (FGM) and comparable to women without FGM.
